instruction: Export all contacts from Thunderbird's Personal Address Book to an Excel file named 'contacts_formatted.xlsx' on the desktop. Format the header row with bold font.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.getWindowsWithTitle('contacts_formatted.xlsx') and pyautogui.getWindowsWithTitle('contacts_formatted.xlsx')[0].activate(); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting contacts with bold formatting on header row. The evaluator comprehensively checks: (1) all header cells are bold, (2) file contains valid contact fields from Thunderbird, (3) file has actual contact data rows, ensuring complete task verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks ALL three instruction requirements (export contacts, correct filename/location, bold header formatting)
Correct bold header verification: Getter checks that ALL header cells are bold (lines 58-59), not just one cell
Valid contact data validation: Getter checks for contact-related field keywords (name, email, phone, etc.) ensuring data comes from Thunderbird's address book
Data completeness check: Metric requires at least 1 row of actual contact data, preventing false positives from empty files with just headers
Robust error handling: Handles missing files, parse errors, empty data, and other edge cases appropriately
Appropriate postconfig: Uses Ctrl+S to save file before evaluation, ensuring state freshness
Logical correctness: Data flow is correct (getter extracts comprehensive state → metric validates all required aspects → returns 1.0 only if all checks pass)
